title: The Vanished Honey Jar
intro: The prize-winning jar of wildflower honey has disappeared from the farmers market's judging table just before the ribbon ceremony.

suspects.name: Gus
suspects.line: I only came for the kettle corn, I swear.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: Honey? Sweet of you to ask, but I was at the bread stall.

suspects.name: Marta
suspects.line: I've been selling tomatoes all morning. Ask anyone.

suspects.name: Tobias
suspects.line: I was judging the pies. Strictly professional.

suspects.name: Lena
suspects.line: Bees and I get along fine, thank you very much.

clues.text: A canvas tote bag was left dangling from the table's edge, its handles still swaying. Whoever hurried off was carrying one on their shoulder.
A napkin with lemonade stains was found, but it was flattened by a different sort of hand. Whoever took the honey did not sip lemonade while doing it.
The baker swears no one from the bread stall was near the judging table at the crucial moment. Their cinnamon rolls were in the oven, and so was the alibi.
Every cup of iced tea sold this morning is accounted for, with lemon slices still floating on top. The iced tea seller had nothing to do with the missing jar.
